run_evaluation: run the MAE-ST ViT model evaluation on the Kinetics test dataset with a pre-trained checkpoint
run_distributed_evaluation: run distributed evaluation of the MAE-ST model across multiple GPUs using launch_one_thread
build_argparse_parser: build an argparse parser for MAE-ST fine-tuning with model, dataset, and distributed training arguments
load_checkpoint: load a pre-trained MAE-ST checkpoint and interpolate position embeddings into the ViT model
create_kinetics_dataset: create a Kinetics video classification test dataset with configurable frame count and sampling rate
